madre.aspetto: a gaunt woman in her fifties with long grey-brown hair, dead, lying in bed under a green checked blanket

parti.occhi: Her eyes are closed, the eyelids slightly sunken and bluish, the skin waxy, grey and still: she is dead.
parti.bocca: Her mouth is slightly open, the lips grey-blue and dry, with a thin line of dried dark blood at one corner: she is dead.

mani.inquadratura: both hands folded on her chest over the green checked blanket, from the wrists to the fingertips
mani.segni: Bony, waxy hands folded around a wooden rosary; the tips of all the fingers are black, dry and shriveled: she is dead.

mostro.aspetto: a woman in her fifties changed by the plague into a monster: ash grey skin with dark veins, completely white eyes without pupils, a mouth too wide with black gums and long yellow teeth, long greasy grey-brown hair, a torn faded floral nightgown, long thin black fingers with black nails

parti.occhi: Her eyes are completely white and blind-looking, without pupils, wide open and staring straight at the viewer, the lids red and raw, the ash grey skin around them cracked with dark veins.

bocca.inquadratura: the mouth, wide open in a snarl, from the tip of the nose to the chin
bocca.segni: The mouth is too wide, stretched open, with black gums, long yellow crooked teeth and black drool at the corners.

mani.inquadratura: one hand gripping the black iron rail of the headboard, from the wrist to the fingertips
mani.segni: The fingers are too long and thin, black like charcoal from the knuckles to the tips, with long curved black nails scratching the paint off the iron rail.
